连续奔波了两天两夜，吴姜早已疲惫不堪，进家的第一件事，就是倒在床上，沉沉睡了过去。

要不是肚子饿的咕咕响，他还不想起来。

王雅琴早就给他包了好多饺子，冻在冰箱里，吴姜起床后，给自己煮了一碗，又给念念盛了一小碗，往念念的碗里滴了几滴百年柳树叶泡的水，念念就能吸了。

另外，又给小丫头点了一根香，小丫头一口饺子一口香，美的鼻子都快冒泡了。

一大一小，同一个姿势，瘫在沙发上看电视，这时，吴姜的阴差令牌有动静了。

吴姜拿出来一看，居然是一条抓捕怨灵的任务。

自从他升到二等鬼差之后，地府就再也没给他派过抓捕怨灵的任务，看来，地府这边是缺人手了，才会把这种小任务派给他。

抓捕怨灵对如今的吴姜来说，早已是手拿把掐，根本费不了多少功夫。

“念念，带你出去锻炼一下！”

没错，这次的任务，吴姜准备交给小丫头了。

念念闻言，眼睛瞬间亮了起来，跃跃欲试地答应道：“好呀好呀！”

她现在的实力，有吴姜照看着，对付一个怨灵，问题不大。

一大一小立刻出发，很容易就找到了那个车祸身亡的怨灵。

来时的念念雄赳赳气昂昂，真的见到怨灵了，立马怂了，吓得缩到了吴姜的身后。

吴姜没好气地伸手，将她从身后提了出来，放在身前，鼓励道：“念念别怕，他就是个普通怨灵，打不过你的，勇敢一点，上！”

念念咬了咬嘴唇，一步三回头地往前挪，那模样既可爱又好笑。

而那个怨灵，看到吴姜，第一时间就吓得想跪下来，念念已经鼓起勇气，挥出一道阴气，朝着怨灵打了过去。

怨灵被念念的阴气打中，痛的“啊”了一声，然后就是五体投地的投降了。

After running around for two days and two nights, Wu Jiang was already exhausted. The first thing he did when he got home was to fall on the bed and fall into a deep sleep.

If his stomach hadn't growled with hunger, he wouldn't have wanted to get up.

Wang Yaqin had made a lot of dumplings for him and froze them in the refrigerator. After Wu Jiang got up, he cooked a bowl for himself and a small bowl for Nian Nian. He put a few drops of water soaked in century-old willow leaves into Nian Nian's bowl so that Nian Nian could drink it.

In addition, I lit another stick of incense for the little girl. The little girl took one bite of the dumplings and her beautiful nose was almost bubbling.

One large and one small, in the same posture, slumped on the sofa watching TV. At this time, Wu Jiang's Yin difference token started to move.

Wu Jiang took it out and saw that it was actually a mission to capture a resentful spirit.

Ever since he was promoted to the second-class ghost officer, the underworld has never assigned him the task of capturing resentful spirits. It seems that the underworld is short of manpower, so it assigns him such a small task.

For Wu Jiang today, catching the resentful spirits is already something he can do at his fingertips, and it doesn't take much effort at all.

"Nian Nian, let's take you out for some exercise!"

That's right, Wu Jiang is going to hand over this task to the little girl.

When Nian Nian heard the words, her eyes lit up instantly and she eagerly agreed: "Okay, okay!"

With her current strength, with Wu Jiang taking care of her, it would not be a big problem to deal with a resentful spirit.

The big one and the small one set off immediately and easily found the resentful spirit who died in the car accident.

Nian Nian was very energetic when he arrived. When he saw the resentful spirit, he immediately became frightened and shrank behind Wu Jiang in fear.

Wu Jiang reached out angrily, lifted her out from behind, put her in front of him, and encouraged: "Don't be afraid Nian Nian, he is just an ordinary resentful spirit, he can't beat you, be brave, come on!"

Nian Nian bit her lip and moved forward, looking back three times. The look was both cute and funny.

As for the resentful spirit, when he saw Wu Jiang, he was so frightened that he wanted to kneel down. Nian Nian had already mustered up the courage to wave a stream of Yin Qi and hit the resentful spirit.

The resentful spirit was hit by Nian Nian's Yin Qi, and he let out a painful "ah", and then surrendered with all his body.
